title: HyDRA: Hybrid Memory for Dynamic Video World Models
summary: HyDRA is a specialized memory architecture for video generation that ensures stable object tracking and re-appearance consistency. It uses a spatiotemporal retrieval mechanism to 'remember' subjects even when they move off-screen or are occluded.
research_notes: The project includes a motion-aware memory tokenizer and is particularly optimized for autonomous driving simulators and Embodied AI world models.

evolution.summary: Released in March 2026, HyDRA is built on the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B architecture and introduces the HM-World dataset for training models on complex object re-entry scenarios.
